climate_pressure: Climate-related pressure on outer-island food and water security.
documented_impact: The UNDP assessment describes existing movement toward crowded Majuro and Ebeye.
fcv_mediator: Unequal land access and limited urban services can mediate settlement and resource pressures.
possible_consequence: Poorly managed movement could increase grievances and resource competition; violence is not established.
alternative_explanations: Employment, education, services and historical relocation also drive mobility.
uncertainty: Source-stated prospective mechanism in the 2023 assessment, not causal attribution or a forecast of violence. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Migration can provide opportunities; inclusive service provision and customary conflict resolution are proposed buffers.
compact_statement: Outer-island livelihood stress may interact with uneven land access and crowded urban services; mobility can also improve opportunities.
